name: Zlin Z-42/Z-142/Z-242 Trener
summary: Czech side-by-side aerobatic trainer with fixed tricycle gear, a sliding canopy and either an inverted inline six or a Lycoming flat-four, widely used by aeroclubs and flying schools.

wings: Low, tapered wing with square-cut tips
engines: Inverted inline six (Z-42/142) or wide flat-four Lycoming (Z-242L)
fuselage: Two seats side by side under a large sliding canopy
Fixed tricycle gear with wheel fairings
tail: Horizontal tail mounted low on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Angular side-by-side aerobatic trainer with fixed tricycle gear and a big sliding canopy
Squared-off tail and square-cut wing tips
Wide, flat-four nose on newer versions (Z-242)

confusedWith.howToTell: The Bulldog has a more bubble-like canopy and a tall swept fin; the Zlin has a more angular tail and square tips.
The DA20 is a smooth composite with a swept-forward look; the Zlin is angular with square-cut surfaces.
The P-Mentor has a bubble canopy and a modern composite look; the Zlin has an angular, boxy tail and cowling.
The SF.260 has retractable gear and tip tanks; the Zlin has fixed gear and no tip tanks.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
